rows.title: Positive available and pending batches
rows.expected: Return only the selected product, complete positive quantities and units; omit zero balances.

rows.title: FEFO ties across pages
rows.expected: Sort expiresAt, receivedAt then UTF-8 batchID before paging; no duplicate or missing rows.

rows.title: Product existence
rows.expected: Existing product without batches is 200 empty; unknown product is authorized 404.

rows.title: Expiry and writeoff
rows.expected: Due expiry uses real owner transition/invalidation; listing never confirms writeoff; post-confirm zero batch disappears on refresh.

rows.title: Settings and DST
rows.expected: Current capture settings and recorded per-batch settings/expiry stay distinct after timezone change; changed settings invalidate old cursor.

rows.title: Concurrent mutation
rows.expected: Capture stays immutable after consumption, delivery or expiry; writes recheck fresh state.

rows.title: Epoch reset
rows.expected: Restart makes cursor unavailable, never combines old and new runtime rows.

rows.title: Business authorization
rows.expected: Waiter cannot stock.read; Warehouse and Admin succeed only for granted restaurant; cross-org identity denied before dispatch.

rows.title: Member contacts
rows.expected: Real joined identity includes nullable legacy email and exact name; no credentials, other-org assignments or invented contact.

rows.title: Member states and roles
rows.expected: Active default, revoked/all filters, exact membership and assignment versions; combined Warehouse/Waiter roles preserved.

rows.title: Invitation list
rows.expected: All existing states/default and state filter; legacy null delivery; latest link job excludes OTP jobs.

rows.title: Read expiry projection
rows.expected: Expired pending invitation projects expired with unchanged persisted version; resendAllowed obeys captured expiry/cooldown.

rows.title: Admin isolation
rows.expected: Employee and other-org Admin denied; deleted org, revoked Admin/session deny cached pages with no leaked rows.

rows.title: Auth capture stability
rows.expected: Profile/session activity and concurrent edits do not change captured names, versions, order or page identity.

rows.title: Cursor bindings
rows.expected: Wrong actor, scope, product, filters or limit cannot use handle; bounded RefreshRequired, no implicit refresh.

rows.title: Cursor expiry and capacity
rows.expected: Five-minute expiry, 128 active snapshot ceiling plus bounded bytes/rows; explicit error, no truncation; end omits cursor.

rows.title: Strict input
rows.expected: Unknown/duplicate query, empty/oversize cursor, limits 0/501, GET body and malformed IDs rejected by both boundaries.

rows.title: Response identity validation
rows.expected: Mismatched org/product/tenant/epoch/state/settings, unexpected fields, negative/numeric quantities and malformed dates fail closed.

rows.title: Create transaction
rows.expected: Confirmed create has one invitation, one link job and one linked command result; 201 remains Invitation; no challenge allocated.

rows.title: Storage failure and unknown
rows.expected: Definite failed commit has no partial acceptance; ambiguous outcome retains original command and recovers exactly one job.

rows.title: Create replay and conflict
rows.expected: Same actor/scope/command/payload returns original invitation/job; changed payload conflicts; restart or changed configured origin does not duplicate.

rows.title: Link resend without OTP
rows.expected: Pending unexpired resend-link needs no challenge; returns one stable job and increments version/cooldown without extending deadline; expired/accepted/revoked/suppressed resends reject before any mutation.

rows.title: Shared cooldown and rate bounds
rows.expected: OTP and link resend enforce shared 60-second deadline; five link resends per invitation per rolling hour; preserve three creates per org/email per rolling ten minutes; combined OTP/link issue limit is 3 per comparison-email target and 60 globally per rolling ten minutes; replay and transport retries not counted; 429 Retry-After preserved.

rows.title: Existing OTP resend
rows.expected: Existing resend still requires live challenge and sends the original OTP kind/deadline; link resend does not mutate challenge.

rows.title: Trusted URL and configuration
rows.expected: Only configured trusted origin; reject hostile Host/redirect, credentials/path/query/fragment; missing config fails before mutation.

rows.title: Link confers no authority
rows.expected: Real link cannot accept membership without existing email-bound OTP/proof; wrong email, expired/revoked scope denied.

rows.title: Delivery result classes
rows.expected: Synthetic SMTP confirmed success, permanent failure and lost reply yield sent/failed/unknown observations respectively.

rows.title: Transport retry and restart
rows.expected: Link jobs have three attempts maximum, retry delays 1/5 minutes and stable jobID/Message-ID; crashed sending becomes unknown; exhausted link unknown stays unknown, no new job; preserve existing OTP retry timing/terminal policy.

rows.title: Cancel/accept/expiry/delete race
rows.expected: Unclaimed jobs suppressed; already claimed IO bounded, result cannot restore access; global User and other org scopes survive.

rows.title: Storage upgrade and legacy replay
rows.expected: Valid v1 upgrades preserve challenge edges/jobs/IDs/deadlines/results; legacy zero-job create replay stays zero; unknown formats and malformed UA1 linkage rejected.

rows.title: Origin and CSRF
rows.expected: Link mutation rejects invalid Origin/CSRF, wrong actor and deleted scope before mutation; no cookies or service material leaked.

rows.title: Privacy and MIME
rows.expected: Escaped text/HTML link, synthetic recipient, expiry, stable Message-ID; no OTP/credential/URL in logs or unrelated third-party channels.

rows.title: Original assertion transition map
rows.expected: Freeze affected all67 assertion IDs and UA1 replacements before runner edits; unchanged assertions remain required; original evidence never overwritten.

rows.title: Source and runtime identities
rows.expected: Full declared owner/Factory gates and live results bind exact source/image/config heads; UA1 is separate from J1/E/J2 and browser acceptance.
